meta.title: Industry Productivity & Pay Atlas — UNIDO INDSTAT Rev.4 plane
meta.variables: 04 Employees, 05 Wages and salaries, 20 Value added (consolidated).

measures.wage_share: Wages & salaries (05) / Value added (20), local currency, within-year ratio.
measures.va_per_emp_usd: Value added (20) per employee (04), current USD — NOMINAL, not real productivity.

meta.valuation_note: Value-added valuation differs by country (UnconsolidatedVariableCode: 17 basic, 18 factor, 19 producer, 20 undefined). The wages/VA ratio cancels currency & valuation within a country-year; cross-country LEVELS are not comparable.
meta.nominal_note: All monetary quantities are NOMINAL (current prices). VA/employee reflects prices, not real output per worker.
meta.suppression_note: Degenerate loss/near-zero-VA observations are shown as missing (null), never zero: wages/VA is kept only when value added and wages are positive and the ratio is <=1.5; VA/employee only when value added (USD) is positive.
meta.separateness: Separate plane from RBI KLEMS and OECD STAN — different labour concepts; do not pool or subtract levels.
